summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing board appointments rather than a special situation. The Johannesburg-listed gold miner advised under JSE Listings Requirements paragraph 6.71 that Mr Alwyn Pretorius and Mr James Boardman were appointed independent non-executive directors effective 15 October 2026. The board confirmed independence and fit-and-proper assessments with no adverse integrity findings. Pretorius is a former Newmont regional executive and prior Harmony COO; Boardman is a CFA with capital-markets and advisory background. Chairman Dr Patrice Motsepe endorsed the additions. No terms, no advisors, no risk-arb angle.
